name: How quickly does mold grow after water damage?

mainEntity.name: How quickly does mold grow after water damage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mold can begin to grow within 24 to 48 hours of water exposure if conditions are favorable. It thrives in damp, dark environments with a food source like wood, drywall, or fabric. Prompt and thorough drying of water-damaged areas is crucial to prevent mold proliferation. Even small leaks or high humidity can create suitable conditions for mold growth over time. Addressing water damage immediately is the best defense against mold development in your property.
acceptedAnswer.description: Mold can start growing within 24 to 48 hours of water damage if moisture is not properly addressed. Immediate drying is key to prevention.
